read_sets.note: What each role is told to read. 2026-11-15 condensation (owner A, research-system-maturation): the charter no longer sends the scheduler to LONG_EFFORT_DESIGN.md at start (it carries the procedure and pastes the §2a/§2b briefs only when it starts a reviewer), so scheduler_start is charter, STATE.md, OPERATOR.md and owner-brief.md. Skill ceilings are the sizes after the condensation (research-coordination SKILL+references+charter 139,190 → ~47 KB). MISSION.md and CHECKPOINT.md are excluded: the desk and the templates do not author them. Steward-channel update (2026-11-15): 605 bytes reserved for the charter's dated, lower-priority STEWARD.md guidance; scheduler read-set ceilings include this addition. Earlier history of these ceilings: measured 2026-11-11 on programme-three-20261111 (charter 36030, STATE.md 6549, long_effort_s2_s3 17945, owner-brief.md 3292). Read-set ceilings lowered 2026-11-15 to the measured sums: scheduler_start 63,816 → 23,000, scheduler_unit 42,677 → 20,600 (measured 22,830 and 20,452; the rest absorbs the test home's temporary path length), owner_start 21,517 → 8,591.
read_sets.owner_topic_note: Each owner also reads its topic's files named here, in topics/<topic>/. They are operator-authored, so they are measured per topic against ceilings.mission_bytes as a flag with a recommended tidy (mission_check.py warns), never a launch gate, and never summed into owner_start_bytes, which bounds skill text only. mission_bytes 40000 is the real spread on 2026-11-12: 25 missions, median 23,266, three-quarters at or under 33,480, two over (local-model-performance 49,806; ai-video-production-and-funnels 71,041).

evidence.defaults: Root and child turn_context of the Web Console Codex sessions that hold the latest goals: b7117dc2-7eda-442f-aebe-bfc62ae5d21b (programme-three-20261111) root gpt-6-luna/medium, 115 children gpt-6-luna/medium; 0551a4e8-c55f-44c5-97fe-77250d331082 (programme-four-20261110) root gpt-6-luna/medium, 55 children gpt-6-luna/medium. Session homes under ~/.vrooli/state/vrooli/web-console/sessions/codex/<id>/. The shared config.toml says gpt-6-luna/high, so a session started by hand from config runs high effort. Owners were started with model and reasoning_effort omitted (inherit).
evidence.models: The Codex models and efforts the research skills allow, from ~/.codex/models_cache.json on 2026-11-11 (gpt-6-luna supports low to max; astra and sol up to ultra). A spec value outside these lists is invalid_spec. Adding a model is an edit here.
